WITH
    ['https://WWW.ClickHouse.com/docs', 'https://GitHub.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse', 'https://www.anthropic.com/news'] AS urls
SELECT
    arrayMap(((lower | domainWithoutWWW) | firstSignificantSubdomain) | upper, urls) AS value,
    toTypeName(value) AS type

WITH
    ['https://WWW.ClickHouse.com/docs', 'https://GitHub.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse', 'https://www.anthropic.com/news'] AS urls
SELECT
    arrayMap(x -> upper(firstSignificantSubdomain(domainWithoutWWW(lower(x)))), urls) AS value,
    toTypeName(value) AS type

SELECT
    arrayMap(trimBoth(_) | upper, [' ClickHouse ', ' Anthropic ', ' OpenAI ']) AS value,
    toTypeName(value) AS type

SELECT
    arrayMap(trim | upper, [' ClickHouse ']) AS value,
    toTypeName(value) AS type

WITH
    [49.99, 189., 19.5] AS prices,
    [2, 1, 4] AS quantities
SELECT
    arrayMap((multiply(_1, _2) | toString) | concat('$', _), prices, quantities) AS value,
    toTypeName(value) AS type

WITH
    [49.99, 189., 19.5] AS prices,
    [2, 1, 4] AS quantities
SELECT
    arrayMap((p, q) -> concat('$', toString(multiply(p, q))), prices, quantities) AS value,
    toTypeName(value) AS type
